reviews.title: Best 10 L case
reviews.comment: The case arrived on time and in excellent conditions. To build in this case requires planning, but very rewarding experience.
reviews.author: Luis

reviews.title: Amazing PC case
reviews.comment: Probably the best case I've ever built in. Nice small form factor, both sides fold up and come off. The top also pops out easily, and it will fit a bigger video card than you would think.
reviews.author: Bigred

reviews.title: Aesthetically amazing
reviews.comment: The case looks great, pretty straight forward to build in but the build quality could be better, one of the locking pins on the the gullwing doors broke on me the first time I tried opening it. Not the end if the of the world, it still sits in place so it looks fine its just doesnt lock in place anymore. Still pleased w the purchase
reviews.author: Slump

reviews.title: Disappointing quality
reviews.comment: The USB port on the front panel is broken, I can't insert anything into it. For $180 I expected a lot better.
reviews.author: Evan

reviews.title: Looks great!
reviews.comment: Great for ITX build. Set for a 2  slot GPU (nvidia FE5080 or 5090) leaves perfect gap for 77m noctua cooler on the cpu.  Recommend. Well constructed.
reviews.author: Denverpixel
